title: DX Roadmap Phase 3: Documentation & Reference
body:
Implements 8/10 items from DX Roadmap Phase 3 — the documentation & reference phase targeting developer adoption post-v3.0.

### New reference pages

- **Field Type Gallery** (`references/data/field-type-gallery.mdx`) — All 48 field types with per-type config tables, examples, and a decision tree
- **Error Code Catalog** (`references/api/error-catalog.mdx`) — 41+ error codes by category with cause/fix/retry strategy, HTTP status mapping, client-side handling patterns
- **Query Syntax Cheat Sheet** (`references/data/query-cheat-sheet.mdx`) — Filter operators, logical combinators, sorting, pagination (offset + cursor), aggregations, joins, full-text search, window functions

### New guides

- **Common Patterns** (`guides/common-patterns.mdx`) — Top 10: CRUD, master-detail, list/kanban views, app nav, flows, approval workflows, AI agents, pagination, field-level security
- **Troubleshooting & FAQ** (`guides/troubleshooting.mdx`) — Validation errors, query debugging, config mistakes, TS type issues, performance
- **Plugin Development Tutorial** (`guides/plugin-development.mdx`) — End-to-end: scaffold → manifest → implement → test → register

### Navigation & roadmap

- Updated `meta.json` for data, api, and guides sections
- `DX_ROADMAP.md` updated — Phase 3 at 8/10 (remaining: visual protocol diagram, wire format JSON examples)
